Read the following statements:
a)
The difference between total expenditure and total revenue is known as ‘revenue
deficit’.
b)
The difference between total expenditure and total receipts except market borrowing
and other liabilities is termed as ‘fiscal deficit’.
c)
The difference between fiscal deficit and interest payment during the year is called
primary deficit.
